title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Haul-Away and Stairs Tariff
content:
Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery sets, for each service level, whether removal of old furniture or a mattress (haul-away) is part of the service or offered for a fee, how many items can be hauled away on one booking, how many flights of stairs the fee includes, and the fee for each flight beyond those.

## Haul-away

| Service level | Haul-away included | Fee for haul-away when not included | Items that can be hauled away per booking |
|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | No | Not offered | Not applicable |
| Threshold Delivery | No | Not offered | Not applicable |
| Room of Choice Delivery | No | $99.00 | 2 |
| White Glove Delivery | No | $79.00 | 2 |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | No | $79.00 | 2 |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | Yes | $0.00 | 3 |

Where a level's haul-away fee is shown as not offered, haul-away is not available at that level. At Premier White Glove with Haul-Away, haul-away is included and its fee is $0.00.

## Stairs

| Service level | Flights of stairs included in the fee | Fee per flight beyond those included |
|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | 0 | Not applicable: stairs are not served |
| Threshold Delivery | 0 | Not applicable: stairs are not served |
| Room of Choice Delivery | 1 | $25.00 |
| White Glove Delivery | 2 | $25.00 |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | 2 | $25.00 |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | 3 | $0.00 |

The fee per further flight is in US dollars to the cent. Curbside Delivery and Threshold Delivery do not serve stairs, which is why their further-flight fee is not applicable.

## Illustrations (hypothetical addresses)

| Level and address | Flights included | Flights beyond those included | Stairs charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Room of Choice Delivery, 1 flight | 1 | 0 | None |
| Room of Choice Delivery, 3 flights | 1 | 2 | $25.00 multiplied by 2, or $50.00 |
| White Glove Delivery, 2 flights | 2 | 0 | None |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly, 4 flights | 2 | 2 | $50.00 |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away, 5 flights | 3 | 2 | $0.00 multiplied by 2, or $0.00 |
